# E0624: the document is not of an OpenAPI version thema converts

`thema lineage init openapi` converts OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 documents, which
declare their version in an `openapi` field. Here the document is OpenAPI 2,
Swagger, which declares `swagger: "2.0"` instead, and keeps its schemas under
`definitions`.

## Example

`swagger.json`:

```json
{
  "swagger": "2.0",
  "info": {"title": "ships", "version": "v1"},
  "paths": {},
  "definitions": {
    "Ship": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}
    }
  }
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0624]: the document declares no OpenAPI version, so it is not an OpenAPI document thema converts
  |
  = help: an OpenAPI 3 document declares its version as a string, as in openapi: "3.0.0"; convert an OpenAPI 2 (Swagger) document to OpenAPI 3 first
```
